info.name: Sciastra Backend API
info.description: API collection for Sciastra microservices backend (Auth, Profile, Connection, Post & Chat services)

item.name: Auth Service

request.description: Send OTP to phone number for authentication. Rate limited to 5 requests per hour per phone number.
Verify OTP and receive access & refresh tokens. Tokens are automatically saved to collection variables.
Refresh access token using refresh token. New access token is automatically saved.
Logout user and invalidate refresh token.
Auth service health check endpoint.

item.description: Authentication service endpoints for OTP-based authentication

item.name: Connection Service

request.description: Send a connection request to another user. Requires authentication.
Accept a pending connection request. Replace :connectionId with actual connection ID.
Reject a pending connection request. Replace :connectionId with actual connection ID.
Get connection requests sent by the authenticated user. Supports pagination.
Get connection requests received by the authenticated user. Supports pagination.
Get all accepted connections for the authenticated user. Supports pagination.
Remove an existing connection. Replace :targetUserId with actual user ID.
Get connection status between authenticated user and target user. Replace :targetUserId with actual user ID.
Connection service health check endpoint.

item.description: Connection service endpoints for managing user connections and networking

request.description: Create a post with text, media, and topics.
Get a post by ID.
Get posts by user ID with pagination.

item.name: Chat Service

request.description: Create a direct (1-on-1) chat room between two users.
Create a group chat room with multiple users.
Get all chat rooms for the authenticated user with pagination.
Get details of a specific chat room including members.
Update the name of a group chat room.
Add new members to an existing group chat.
Remove a member from a group chat. Replace :memberId with actual user ID.
Send a text message to a chat room.
Send a message with media attachments to a chat room.
Get messages from a chat room with pagination.
Get messages from a chat room before a specific timestamp (for infinite scroll).
Mark a specific message as read by the current user.
Chat service health check endpoint.

item.description: Chat service endpoints for real-time messaging, chat rooms, and WebSocket functionality
